therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: HER2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate combined with CDK4/6 kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: HER2-positive tumor cell targeting with cell cycle arrest

results.effect_size: Median PFS 16.9 months (95% CI: 8.3–NA) vs 8.3 months (95% CI: 2.7–8.8) for single agent T-DM1
safety_signals: Gastrointestinal toxicities (colitis, enterocolitis, upper GI hemorrhage)
results.dose_information: Palbociclib 125mg orally days 5-18 of 21-day cycle; T-DM1 3.6 mg/kg IV on day 1 of every 21-day cycle
